bending_loss_study.scope: Classic Auditorium/Mahogany Pick/Thumb,4 physical-string/note anchors,both microphones;12 small Original controls. Both planes use identical intrinsic factors.
bending_loss_study.conclusion: A uniform modest bending multiplier changes wound-string partials much more than the persistent plain-string treble. Not advocated as a treble sustain fix.

broad_loss_study.global_transfer_limit: Original stronger-option middle RMS drops1.97–3.02dB. Local Classic observations do not justify global adoption.
